crossRefs.note: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, Yahweh…
Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
‘Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.
for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.
I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for…
So Yahweh gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.
translations.bsb: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel. May You restore them to the land You gave to them and their fathers.
translations.kjv: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
translations.asv: then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
